verdict.rationale: dLocal documents a Sandbox, managed from the same account as production, where you can safely simulate payments, check API behavior and trigger webhooks without real transactions. You can also force payment outcomes such as declines by passing a status code in the `description` field. There is no evidence of a test-card catalog, dispute or chargeback simulation, or a claim that the sandbox mirrors production behavior. missing for 10: documented test cards per scenario, dispute/chargeback simulation in sandbox, evidence of production parity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
